s: ukAraH । paYcamasvaravarRaH । asyoccAraRaM AzWaH । (yaTA, SikzAgranTe । “kaRWyA vahAvicuyaSAstAlavyA ozWajAvupU” । taTA ca mugDaboDe । “utrayaM paPabaBamavA o OzWyAH” .) sa ca hrasvo dIrGaH plutaSca Bavati । (evaM triDApi pratyekaM udAttAnudAttasvaritaBedena navamasaNKyakaH punaH pratyekaM anunAsikAnanunAsikaBedAt azwAdaSaviDa eva Bavati । asya DyAnamAha .) “ukAraM parameSAni aDaHkuRqalinI svayam । pItacampakasaNkASaM paYcadevamayaM sadA ॥ paYcaprARamayaM devi caturvvargapradAyakam” । iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ (vaNgIyaBAzAyAM) asya leKanaprakAroyaTA, -- “UrdDvADo maDyataH kubjA reKA vAmagatA SuBA । tizWanti vAyuvahnIndrAH SaktirmAtrA parA smftA” ॥ iti varRodDAratantram ॥ asya nAmAntarARi yaTA, -- “uH SaNkaro varttulAkzI BUtaH kalyARavAcakaH । amareSo dakzakarRaH zaqvaktro mohanaH SivaH ॥ ugraH praBurDftirvizRurviSvakarmmA maheSvaraH । SatruGnaScawikA puzwiH paYcamI vahnivAsinI ॥ kAmaGnaH kAmanA ceSo mohinI viGnahfnmahI । uQasUH kuwilA SrotraM pAradvIpo vfzo haraH” ॥ iti tantroktavarRABiDAnam ॥ (mAtfkAnyAse'sya dakziRakarRe sTAnam । yaduktaM mAtfkAnyAsamantre “uM namo dakziRakarRe UM namo vAmakarRe” .)
Na, Sabde । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAdiM-AtmaM akaM-aniw .) Na avate gOH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

vya, (u Sabwe + kvip + tuk na .) samboDanam । rIzoktiH । anukampA । niyogaH । padapUraRaM । pAdapUraRaM । iti medinI ॥ praSnaH । aNgIkAraH । iti hemacandraH ॥ idameva uN iti KyAtaM ॥ (“umeti mAtrA tapaso nizidDA, paScAdumAKyAM sumuKI jagAma” ॥ iti kumAre । 1 । 26 ॥)

puM, (atati viSvamayatvAt sarvvaM vyApnotIti । at + qu .) SivaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (“akAro vizRuruddizwa ukArastu maheSvaraH । makAreRocyate brahmA praRavena trayo matAH” ॥ iti purARe .) brahmA । iti kaScidekAkzarakozaH ॥
v: Sabde BvAdi॰ aka॰ A॰ aniw । avate Ozwa । uve otA ozIzwa ozyate Ozyata । avanam utaH । “uve amba sulABike yaTevANga Bavizyati” f॰ 10, 86, 7 ।

avya॰ u--kvip na tuk । 1 samboDane 2 kopavacane, 3 anukampAyAM, 4 niyoge (avaDAraRe) “umeti mAtrA tapase nizidDA paScAdumAKyAM sumuKI jagAma” kumA॰ । “udu zya devaH savitA sa, vAya” f॰ 2, 38, 1 । “upo ruruce yuvatirna yozA” f॰ 7, 77, 1 । “vetTo yaTemaM lokaM punarApadyanta iti” vfha॰ u॰ । “eza u evAsADu karmma kArayati tam” SrutiH 5 aNgIkAre 6 praSne ca” hemaca॰ 7 pAdapUraRe । atati sAtatyena tizWati ata--qu । 8 Sive pu॰ । svarUpArTe kAraH ukAro'pi Sive “akAro vizRuruddizwa ukArastu maheSvaMraH । makArastu smfto brahmA praRavastu trayArTakaH” iti omityasya avayavArTanirUpaRe purA॰ । uSabdAt svarUpArTe kAraH । ukAraH । paYcamasvare । sa ca uttAnudAttasvaritaBedena prayamaM triDA punaH anunAsikA nanunAsikaBedena pratyekaM dviDeti zawviDaH kAratakArAnuttarastu hrasvadIrGaptutaBedena triviDo'pi pratyekaM prAguktaBedazawkAt azwAdaSaviDaH । tasya varRasya kURqalinIrUtvAdinADyeyatvamuktam kAmaDenutantre yaTA “ukAraM parameSAni । viduH kuRqalinIM svayam । pItacampakasaNkASaM paYcadevaM sadA'malam । paYcaprARamayaM devi! caturvargapradAyakam” tantrAntare akArokAramakArAtmakapraRavasya maDye dvAdaSakalAtmakArkamaRqalarUpeRa akArasya, zoqaSakalAtmakacandramaRqalarUpeRa ukArasya, daSakalAtmakavahnimaRqalarUpeRa ca makArasya DyeyatvoktyA aBedopacArAt zoqaSakalA tmake, 9 candramaRqale ca tatra makArAntasyEva tannAmateti bahavaH । u, ityasya ekAj nipAtatvAt pragfhyasaMjYA tena aci pare na sanDiH । u--umeSaH” si॰ kO॰ । “eza u vAsADukarmma kArayati tam” SrutiH । sa cacAdigaRIyaH ।

“uH SaNkarovarttulAkzo BUtaHkalyARavAcakaH । amareSodakzakarRRaH zaqvaktromohanaH SivaH । ugraHpraBurDftirvizRuH viSvakarmmA maheSvaraH । SatruGnaSca kawiH puzwiH paYcamI vahnivAsinI । kAmaGnaH kamalAveSo mohinI viGnahfnmahI । tawasUH kuwilA SrotraM pArahIno vfzoharaH” ।
“ukAraM parameSAni! aDaHkuRqalinIM svayam । pItacampakasaNkASaM paYcadevamayaMsadA । paYcaprARamayaM devi! caturvargapradAyakam ।
m: 1. उ the fifth letter and third short vowel of the alphabet, pronounced as the u in full.
2. उ ind. an interjection of compassion, anger, L.
a particle implying assent, calling, command, L.
3. उ ind. an enclitic copula used frequently in the Vedas;

(as a particle implying restriction and antithesis, generally after pronominals, prepositions, particles, and before नु and सु, equivalent to) and, also, further; on the other hand (especially in connexion with a relative, e.g. य उ, he on the contrary who &c.)

This particle may serve to give emphasis, like इद् and एव, especially after prepositions or demonstrative pronouns, in conjunction with नु, वै, हि, चिद्, &c. (e.g. अयम् उ वाम् पुरुतमो … जोहवीति [RV. iii, 62, 2], this very person [your worshipper] invokes you &c.) It is especially used in the figure of speech called Anaphora, and particularly when the pronouns are repeated (e.g. तम् उ स्तुष इन्द्रम् तम् गृणीषे [RV. ii, 20, 4], him I praise, Indra, him I sing). It may be used in drawing a conclusion, like the English ‘now’ (e.g. तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् [ŚBr. v, 2, 2, 3], that now he should not do in such a manner), and is frequently found in interrogative sentences (e.g. क उ तच् चिकेत [RV. i, 164, 48], who, I ask, should know that?)
Pāṇini calls this particle उञ् to distinguish it from the interrogative उ. In the Pada-pāṭha it is written ऊम्.
In the classical language उ occurs only after अथ, न, and किम्, with a slight modification of the sense, and often only as an expletive (see किम्);
उ — उ or उ — उत, on the one hand — on the other hand; partly — partly; as well — as.
4. उ cl. 5. P. उनोति (see व्य्-उ, RV. v, 31, 1) : cl. 2. Ā. (1. sg. उवे, RV. x, 86, 7) : cl. 1. Ā. अवते, Dhātup.; to call to, hail; to roar, bellow (see also ओत = आ-उत).
a: उ — {vI.v} {c1c} A. (अवते, ऊवे, औष्ट, ओतुं, उत) 1 To sound, make a noise. --2 To roar, bellow (as a bull &c.). {vII.v} {c5c} P. (उनोति) Ved. To ask, demand.

उः — 1 N. of Śiva, the second of the three syllables in ओम्; see अ. --2 N. of Brahmā. --3 The orb of the moon. --ind. 1 As a particle used expletively; उ उमेशः Sk. --2 An interjection of:-- (a) calling; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम Ku. 1. 26; (b) anger; (c) compassion; (d) command; (e) acceptance; (f) interrogation; or (g) used merely as an expletive. In the Veda used as an enclitic copula implying restriction and emphasis (and, but, on the other hand, now, I ask &c.); in classical literature used chiefly with अथ (अथो), न (नो) and किम् (किमु); see these words. उ-उ or उत on the one hand-on the other hand, partly-partly.

k.v: अस्ति सत्वे रुषोक्तावु ऊं प्रश्नेऽनुनये त्वयि। हुं तर्के स्यादुषा रात्रेरवसाने नमो नतौ॥
